notes.en: Only the deprecated `legacyImgSize` variant is compared: `imgSize` (`![alt =100x200](url)`) and `obsidianImgSize` (`![alt|100x200](url)`) are extensions of this package with no equivalent in `markdown-it-imsize`.

notes.en: The current package treats a dimension whose numeric value is `0` as unspecified and rejects a size whose width and height are both `0`; the reference emits the literal `0`. `zero-width`, `zero-height`, `zero-both` and `zero-percent-width` document this.
notes.zh: 当前包将数值为 `0` 的维度视为未指定，并拒绝宽高均为 `0` 的尺寸；参考包会原样输出 `0`。`zero-width`、`zero-height`、`zero-both` 和 `zero-percent-width` 记录了这一点。

notes.en: The current package accepts a single trailing `%` per dimension (the documented syntax); the reference's number scanner accepts `%` anywhere, so `=5%0x3%0` is parsed by the reference only. Documented in `percent-in-middle`.
notes.zh: 当前包对每个维度只接受一个末尾 `%`（文档中的语法）；参考包的数字扫描器接受任意位置的 `%`，因此 `=5%0x3%0` 只有参考包会解析。已在 `percent-in-middle` 中记录。

notes.en: The current package accepts any whitespace before the size specification, while the reference requires a literal space (its check is `charCodeAt(pos - 1) === 0x20`); `tab-before-size` is therefore parsed by the current package only.
notes.zh: 当前包接受尺寸规格前的任意空白，而参考包要求一个字面空格（其检查为 `charCodeAt(pos - 1) === 0x20`）；因此 `tab-before-size` 只有当前包会解析。

notes.en: The reference `autofill` option is not compared: it reads image files from disk (`image-size`) and its output depends on the filesystem.
notes.zh: 不对比参考包的 `autofill` 选项：它会从磁盘读取图片文件（`image-size`），输出依赖文件系统。

notes.en: Scaling: the reference image rule re-attempts `parseLinkLabel` for every `![` opener and parses every label again; malformed sizes fall back to the core image rule. markdown-it caches `skipToken` positions, so all series stay ~linear (no superlinear behavior was found in the upstream implementation).
notes.zh: 扩展性：参考包的图片规则会为每个 `![` 起始符重新尝试 `parseLinkLabel`，并再次解析每个 label；格式错误的尺寸会回退到核心 image 规则。markdown-it 会缓存 `skipToken` 位置，因此所有序列都保持近似线性（上游实现中未发现超线性行为）。
